from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class QuarterlyExpense(BaseModel):
    """Non-operating expenses reported in one quarterly financial document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name, as named in the document")
    year: int | None = Field(description="The calendar year of this quarter")
    quarter: int | None = Field(description="The quarter number (1-4)")
    period_type: str | None = Field(description="Whether this is single quarter or year-to-date cumulative")
    non_operating_expenses: float | None = Field(description="The non-operating expenses amount reported")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元', '美元'")
    comparison_to_which_year: int | None = Field(description="If year-over-year comparison exists, the prior year of comparison")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A brief excerpt or reference anchor from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    quarterly_expenses: list[QuarterlyExpense]
